## tmh learners list

List all learners

### Synopsis

Returns a list of the organization's learners in one course, with each learner's status, dates and current certificate. Filter by `status`, or find one learner by `email` or `externalId`.

--all follows every page, keeping the other flags, and prints all the items as one JSON array, so `| jq` works; add --ndjson to print one compact item per line as each page arrives.

Scopes: learners:read

```
tmh learners list [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --all                      follow every page and print all the items as one JSON array; --limit sets the page size
      --course-id string         The course. Defaults to the organization's default course.
      --cursor nextCursor        The nextCursor from the previous page.
      --email string             Email
      --external-id externalId   The integration's own id for the learner (unique per organization), or the SCIM externalId when none was set.
  -h, --help                     help for list
      --limit int                How many objects to return, between 1 and 100. Defaults to 20.
      --ndjson                   with --all, print one compact JSON item per line as each page arrives
      --status string            Status; one of: not_started, invite_bounced, in_progress, compliant, expiring_soon, expired, removed
```
